whatItFakes: The Money sheet lists the six most recent monthly cash rows; six is a display window, not a measured span.
why: The credit engine keeps one household row per monthly review with no limit, and the sheet needs some length; no parameter table row sets how far back a player looks.
replacement: A TUNABLE display window in the parameter table, checked against how many months a player scrolls back, or a chart that draws every kept row.

whatItFakes: Where last month went is grouped by the contract kind on each standing bill’s latest receipt plus the everyday living plan, standing in for the transfer’s reasonKey; a one-off transfer (a purchase, a fee, a gift) is not listed.
why: The accounts engine (src/core2/accounts.ts) returns a transfer’s reasonKey on its receipt but keeps neither the receipt nor the reason; the cash journal keeps postings and a source id only, and the finance engine keeps only the latest receipt per standing contract.
replacement: The accounts engine keeping each household transfer’s reasonKey on its journal receipt, so the sheet groups every outflow of the month by it.
